description: Registry of every event type allowed in version 2 (Step 0, blueprint 42 A). A type not listed here is quarantined by LynkCCBox. Money is an integer in the currency's minor unit and every payload that carries money carries its ISO 4217 currency, listed in contract/currencies.v1.json (decimals for display only). Quantities are integer thousandths. Version 1 events (integer RWF) stay readable through the upcaster in contract/upcasters.v1.json. Generated by contract/tools/build_v2.py; never hand-edited.

p256_public_key.description: Uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes), base64url, no padding.

money.description: Integer minor units of the payload's currency.

period.description: A year, a month or a day.

username.description: The shared username rule (blueprint 44 B, core/usernames.py).
